name: Shlok Vaishnav
role: Computer science undergraduate working on machine learning and systems
bio: I am a computer science undergraduate at Nirma University. I work on machine learning and systems, and I like research ideas that are made fast, reliable and deployable.

Right now I map castor fields from multispectral satellite imagery at Bull Agritech, and I extract the shape of lunar impact craters from Chandrayaan elevation data on an ISRO-funded research fellowship.
I build engines from scratch to understand them: a vector database in C++, an LLM inference engine with paged attention, and an agent that rediscovers physics equations.
availability: Open to internships and research collaborations.
